description: This file defines the NotesWidgetViewsFactory class, which provides data and views for a widget displaying notes in an Android application. It interacts with a NoteRepository to retrieve notes, formats them for display, and creates RemoteViews for each note item.

classes.name: NotesWidgetViewsFactory
classes.description: A factory class for providing views for each note displayed in a widget, implementing RemoteViewsFactory, using dependency injection for the NoteRepository, and formatting note data for display.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Loads and filters notes from the repository when data has changed.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Clears the note data when the factory is destroyed.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notes loaded for display.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Creates and returns a RemoteViews object for a specific note at the given position.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns null, indicating the default loading view.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types, which is 1.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the given position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that item IDs are stable.

calls: Log.e("NotesWidgetFactory", "Error creating view at position $position", e)
